# StartSaldo

> Personal financial accounting and payroll for Swiss SMEs and start-ups, from Rothenthurm (canton Schwyz) – including companies with crypto transactions.

StartSaldo is the accounting brand of Digital Trust Solutions GmbH (UID CHE-147.018.858). We take over bookkeeping, payroll, VAT returns, tax returns and annual accounts for Swiss limited companies (SMEs and start-ups). We work fully digitally: documents are exchanged via a secure Proton share link, and data is stored with Proton, a Swiss provider of encrypted email and cloud storage.

We are a small, personal team: Audelia Babbev-Pittet (financial accountant), Sarah Mogel (payroll and social insurance specialist) and Daniel Babbev (general manager). The initial consultation is free and non-binding.

## Services

- [Financial accounting](https://www.startsaldo.ch/finanzbuchhaltung): Ongoing bookkeeping for Swiss SMEs and start-ups.
- [Payroll](https://www.startsaldo.ch/lohnbuchhaltung): Monthly payroll runs, social insurance and payslips.
- [VAT returns](https://www.startsaldo.ch/mwst): Quarterly and annual VAT reporting in Switzerland.
- [Tax returns](https://www.startsaldo.ch/steuern): Corporate tax returns for limited companies.
- [Annual accounts](https://www.startsaldo.ch/jahresabschluss): Annual statements prepared and filed on time.
- [Crypto accounting](https://www.startsaldo.ch/krypto): Accounting and taxes for companies with crypto transactions.
- [Founders & start-ups](https://www.startsaldo.ch/gruendung-startups): Support around a company formation, up to the commercial register entry.

## Regions

- [Canton Schwyz](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-schwyz): Accounting for companies in the canton of Schwyz, based in Rothenthurm.
- [Canton Zug](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-zug): Accounting for companies in the canton of Zug.
- [Ausserschwyz & Höfe](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-ausserschwyz): Accounting for Wollerau, Freienbach, Pfäffikon SZ, Bäch and the March district.

- [Canton Zurich](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-zuerich): Personal, digital accounting for SMEs and start-ups in Zurich, supported from Rothenthurm. [English](https://www.startsaldo.ch/en/accounting-zurich).
- [Canton Lucerne](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-luzern): Full or partial accounting outsourcing for SMEs and start-ups in Lucerne. [English](https://www.startsaldo.ch/en/accounting-lucerne).

- [Aargau](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-aargau): Accounting for SMEs and start-ups, digitally supported from Rothenthurm. [English](https://www.startsaldo.ch/en/accounting-aargau).
- [St. Gallen](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-st-gallen): Accounting for SMEs and start-ups, digitally supported from Rothenthurm. [English](https://www.startsaldo.ch/en/accounting-st-gallen).
- [Bern](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-bern): Accounting for SMEs and start-ups, digitally supported from Rothenthurm. [English](https://www.startsaldo.ch/en/accounting-bern).
- [Basel](https://www.startsaldo.ch/buchhaltung-basel): Accounting for SMEs and start-ups, digitally supported from Rothenthurm. [English](https://www.startsaldo.ch/en/accounting-basel).
